summary: Adopt strict SemVer release governance, local Git commits as development identities, structured annotated release tags, and correct the malformed v0.6.0.5 release identity to v0.6.1.

candidates.rationale: Correct the public release identity to strict SemVer v0.6.1 while preserving runtime semantics.
Add human-readable and machine-readable release/version governance.
Route release work selectively without loading release policy during unrelated tasks.
Make SemVer, release-policy, and structured annotated-tag-note rules mechanically testable.
Document the release validator in the deterministic tools route.

applied_changes.description: Updated release metadata and regression expectation to v0.6.1.
Added release validator and regression tests.
Documented the release validator in tool context.
